overview_description.description:
Pair Team is on a mission to build the primary care infrastructure for vulnerable communities.

They are the first tech-enabled care team that empowers safety-net primary care systems and the Medicaid & Medicare patients they serve. They act as an extension of the clinical staff to provide a personalized, high-touch care experience while addressing patients' barriers to care such as lack of transportation, housing/food insecurity, and mobile phone access. Internally, they are building a unique care delivery platform to ensure clinical best practices, integrate care with community-based organizations, and automate administrative work so clinicians can focus on patient time.

product.name: Whole-Person Care Delivery Platform
product.description: A care coordination platform that connects medical, behavioral, and social services for Medicaid and Medicare members, care teams, and community organizations.

product.name: Flora AI Care Advocate
product.description: An AI-supported care advocate that engages members by phone or text, answers care-navigation questions, coordinates resources, and escalates issues to clinical staff.

product.name: Medi-Cal Enhanced Care Management
product.description: A California Medi-Cal care-management program for members with complex medical, behavioral, or social needs, including chronic conditions, housing instability, and food insecurity.

identifier.value: Medicare Ongoing Support for Everyday Health

product.name: Medicare Ongoing Support for Everyday Health
product.description: A Medicare member-support service combining Flora with a clinical care team to coordinate healthcare and everyday needs.

product.name: Health Plan Community-Integrated Care
product.description: A care-management service for health plans serving high-need Medicaid, Medicare, and dual-eligible members through community health workers, clinicians, AI coordination, and local referrals.

product.name: Pair Impact Network
product.description: A community-partner program that provides local organizations with care-coordination tools, funding, staffing support, and referrals to expand services for Medicaid and Medicare members.
